## Specific task description

Task instruction: Lift the thin rectangular laptop using the right arm

Task description: The laptop is just right of center on the table, with a fixed base and a slightly open lid. Use the right arm to lift the lid further around its hinge.

Success criteria: The lid is opened to at least 40% of its full opening range, while the right arm's gripper end remains near the designated interaction point on the laptop.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the free edge of the lid away from the hinge, choosing a section clear of both corners and wide enough for pad contact to get a better contact area and opening leverage.
- Match the opening to lid thickness and the existing gap, with fingers surrounding its inner and outer faces. Before closing, confirm the finger inside the gap is not pressing against the base, avoiding gripping the upper and lower parts together.
- When lifting the lid, gradually adjust the gripper position and pose along the hinge’s rotation, leaving room for the curved motion of the lid’s free edge. Avoid pulling along a fixed straight line, which could cause slipping or jamming.
